headline: Acer's Predator Atlas 8 handheld launches in US at Best Buy
summary: Acer's Predator Atlas 8 gaming handheld is launching in the US for the first time, arriving exclusively at Best Buy on November 1 for $1,300 in its more powerful Intel Arc G3 Extreme configuration.
